name: open-detectors
description: Openly available prompt-injection detectors on matched benign/attack pairs in English and Turkish.

datasets.title: Agentic boundary pairs, English, test split
datasets.note: 120 matched pairs from enterprise and agent workflows, 10 per attack family. The benign twin shares the asset, role, tool and topic of its attack. The test split uses scenarios that do not occur in the train split.

datasets.title: Agentic boundary pairs, English, all splits
datasets.note: All 600 matched pairs, 50 per attack family, for per-family numbers with tighter intervals. Detectors that were trained on the train split of this dataset have seen 420 of these pairs; they are marked in the table.

datasets.title: Conversation prompt injection, Turkish, all splits
datasets.note: 150 matched pairs plus 450 ordinary benign messages, all in Turkish. The category slice separates ordinary benign messages from benign twins.

datasets.title: Benign prompts with alarming words, Turkish and English
datasets.note: 120 benign prompts, each in Turkish and in English, so the two languages can be compared on the same items. Only the benign half of the set is used: its other half consists of harmful requests, which are not prompt injections, so an injection detector is not expected to flag them.

detectors.title: regex-baseline (built in)
detectors.note: Reference floor: a list of known attack phrases.

detectors.title: protectai/deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection-v2
detectors.languages: English only according to its model card

detectors.title: deepset/deberta-v3-base-injection
detectors.languages: English and German according to its metadata

detectors.title: fmops/distilbert-prompt-injection
detectors.languages: English, German and Spanish according to its metadata
detectors.note: The model does not name its outputs; LABEL_1 is taken as the attack class.

detectors.title: patronus-studio/wolf-defender-prompt-injection
detectors.languages: English and German are the primary evaluated languages according to its model card; multilingual base model
detectors.note: Its model card reports results on the boundary-pairs dataset and does not say whether that dataset was part of the training data.

detectors.title: Horizon-Labs/prompt-injection-guard-base
detectors.languages: Trained on synthetic data in 30 languages according to its model card, Turkish included
detectors.note: Its model card lists the train split of the boundary-pairs dataset among its training data.

detectors.title: NeuralTrust/prompt-guard-oss-small
detectors.languages: Trained and evaluated on nine languages according to its model card, Turkish included
